channel.title: Deep Rest Practice Journal
channel.description: Short reads on the research behind relaxation.

item.title: Yoga Nidra for Sleep: What a Review of Trials Found
item.description: A systematic review of six randomised trials looked at yoga nidra for sleep. Here is what it found, what it could not show, and how to try it gently.

item.title: NSDR and Yoga Nidra: What the Research Says
item.description: NSDR, or non-sleep deep rest, draws on the older practice of yoga nidra. A 2022 review looks at what the research can and cannot show.
